title: Yeast permease and sugar isomers
change: New organism and sugar pair (galactose/glucose) with a transporter in yeast; shape-based recognition of isomers.

title: Same amino acids different order
change: Moves from sugar isomers to peptide sequence isomers; same principle that arrangement of identical atoms changes shape and recognition.

title: Surface leucine causes aggregation
change: New enzyme and a polar-to-nonpolar surface swap causing aggregation; no disease context.

title: Loss of ionic attraction between subunits
change: Tests R-group ionic interactions at a quaternary interface rather than hydrophobic polymerization; new protein and reversed charge logic.

title: Buried hydrophobic residue replaced by charged residue
change: Buried nonpolar to charged substitution tests tertiary structure stability; contrasts with seed's surface-exposed residue.

title: Cell classification with flagellum and chloroplast
change: New cell pair (flagellated bacterium vs algal-type eukaryote) with distractors about flagella and walls.

title: Large prokaryote and small eukaryote
change: Size reversed relative to seed (large prokaryote, small eukaryote) to test structural criteria over size.

title: Potato core mass change in sucrose
change: New plant tissue and data (sucrose mass change, recomputed -14%) asking why the tissue wilts rather than why it stays intact.

title: Protoplasts burst in water
change: Wall-removal experiment (protoplasts) tests the same wall/turgor reasoning with different evidence.

title: Wilting of plants in salty soil
change: Flip of seed: loss of turgor in hypertonic conditions in a garden setting.

title: Transferrin receptor deficiency
change: Different ligand/receptor (transferrin) in a new cell type; same prediction skill with a receptor loss.

title: Blocked vesicle fusion in beta cells
change: Exocytosis instead of receptor-mediated endocytosis; same membrane-transport prediction skill.

title: Drug that blocks vesicle formation
change: Different step blocked (inward folding after binding) forces reasoning about sequence of the endocytosis steps.

title: Assign osmolarities to cell outcomes
change: Different animal-cell cytoplasm value (280) and different symptoms/labels; matching outcomes to osmolarities.

title: Predicting outcomes from osmolarity
change: Reverse direction (predict outcomes from osmolarity) with impermeant solutes; values recomputed as hypo/iso/hypertonic.

title: Order solutions by osmolarity from volume data
change: Quantitative data table (percent volume change) must be converted into a rank order of osmolarity.

title: Blocked Golgi-to-membrane vesicles in plasma cells
change: Plasma cell antibody secretion with a later block (Golgi vesicle fusion) than the seed's ER-to-Golgi block.

title: Drug blocks lysosomal enzyme packaging
change: Lysosome-bound protein pathway instead of secretion; same ER-Golgi-vesicle sequence logic.

title: Cell type with extensive rough ER and Golgi
change: Application item: matches cell function to organelle abundance instead of predicting a drug outcome; same topic.

title: Chloroplast engulfment evidence
change: Chloroplast version of the engulfment-evidence item with distractors tied to genome, ribosomes and division.

title: Antibiotic prediction from endosymbiosis
change: Predictive application of endosymbiosis (ribosome type and antibiotic) rather than picking evidence.

title: Channel protein surface chemistry
change: Channel with two distinct surfaces (outer lipid-contacting, inner pore) instead of one nonpolar surface.

title: Peripheral protein removed by salt
change: Peripheral rather than integral protein; polar surface and gentle release as evidence.

title: Hydrophobic stretches in membrane protein sequence
change: Inference from primary sequence pattern (nonpolar stretches) plus detergent evidence to membrane-spanning protein.
